1. (Currently amended) A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a forward section constructed from an open rib structure __with a first fore-aft rib and transverse ribs projecting therefrom__; and an aero cover carried on said body panel and spanning said open rib structure, __wherein said aero cover is integrally formed with said body panel as a single molded component__.

2. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 1, wherein said body panel includes a first forward corner and a second forward corner, __and wherein said body panel is constructed from polypropylene reinforced with 40% long glass fibers__.

3. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 2, wherein said first forward corner includes a first section of open rib structure and said second forward corner includes a second section of open rib structure, __wherein each section is bounded by closed ribs on opposed sides__.

4. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 3, including a first aero cover spanning and closing said first section of open rib structure and a second aero cover spanning and closing said second section of open rib structure, __wherein said first and second aero covers are each integrally formed with said body panel__.

5. (Previously presented) The belly pan of claim 4, wherein said first section of open rib structure includes a first fore-aft rib and a first plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said first fore-aft rib.

6. (Previously presented) The belly pan of claim 5, wherein said second section of open rib structure includes a second fore-aft rib and a second plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said second fore-aft rib.

7. (Previously presented) The belly pan of claim 6, wherein said body panel includes a plurality of closed ribs, said first section of open rib structure being provided between a first two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs and said second section of open rib structure being provided between a second two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs.

8. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 7, including fasteners securing said first aero cover and said second aero cover to said body panel, __wherein said fasteners are positioned to avoid penetrating said open rib structures__.

9. (Previously presented) The belly pan of claim 8, wherein said body panel includes a first corner buttress and a second corner buttress.

10. (Previously presented) The belly pan of claim 9, wherein said first section of open rib structure forms a part of said first buttress and said second section of open rib structure forms a part of said second buttress.

11. (Cancelled)

12. (Cancelled)

13. (Cancelled)

14. (Cancelled)

15. (Currently amended) A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a first corner buttress, a second corner buttress, a first open rib structure reinforcing said first corner buttress and a second open rib structure reinforcing said second corner buttress, __wherein said first and second open rib structures each include a fore-aft rib with transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides thereof, and wherein said body panel is constructed from polypropylene reinforced with 40% long glass fibers__; a first aero cover spanning and closing said first open rib structure, __said first aero cover integrally formed with said body panel__; and a second aero cover spanning and closing said second open rib structure, __said second aero cover integrally formed with said body panel__.

16. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 15, wherein said body panel includes a first section and a second section __that are integrally formed together__ [[secured together by fasteners]].

17. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 16, wherein said first corner buttress is on said first section and said second corner buttress is on said second section, __and wherein said first and second sections are joined along a centerline of said body panel__.

18. (Previously presented) The belly pan of claim 17, wherein said first open rib structure includes a first fore-aft rib and a first plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said first fore-aft rib.

19. (Previously presented) The belly pan of claim 18, wherein said second open rib structure includes a second fore-aft rib and a second plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said second fore-aft rib.

20. (Previously presented) The belly pan of claim 19, wherein said body panel includes a plurality of closed ribs, said first section of open rib structure being provided between a first two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs and said second section of open rib structure being provided between a second two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs.
